question: Should this PR's fail-closed classification for explicit `CRABBOX_CONFIG` files inside the active repository be accepted as Crabbox's provider credential destination boundary?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it deliberately turns some previously accepted repo-local explicit config workflows into validation failures for inherited credentials, which is a security-boundary and upgrade-safety choice.

options.title: Accept fail-closed repo config trust
options.body: Require proof and remove the changelog line, then land the classifier so repo-local explicit config cannot approve inherited credential destinations.

options.title: Add a compatibility escape hatch
options.body: Pause this PR and design an explicit opt-in approval path if maintainers want to preserve any existing repo-local `CRABBOX_CONFIG` workflows.

options.title: Reject this boundary change
options.body: Keep the old explicit-config trust behavior and address the report through documentation or a different endpoint validation rule.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed repo config trust
recommendation.body: Require proof and remove the changelog line, then land the classifier so repo-local explicit config cannot approve inherited credential destinations.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main history and this PR both point to steipete for the config/provenance implementation path.
